answer: Checking is dull by design: the record is open, the mark is checked, the date is fixed. One nadir is a pass, one ledge is a fare, one dune is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. The fine for one forgery is 4 times the stake, so a 70 POA proof becomes a 4x loss when the panel finds it. Give the epoch a backbone: Ivory box maker horn handle proof carved within the horn shed, proved by each horn handle is a year of turning logs in the ivory ledger, checked by strangers.
